sentences.en: The new printer is cost effective for small offices.
sentences.zh: 对于小型办公室来说，新打印机的性价比很高。

sentences.en: Using public transportation is generally more cost effective than driving a car.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，使用公共交通比开车更加经济实惠。

sentences.en: Buying in bulk can be very cost effective for regular users of this product.
sentences.zh: 对于经常使用该产品的用户来说，批量购买会非常划算。

senses.zh: [短语]性价比较高的;本轻利厚的;
